newsitem.title: USA: Procter buys 3 brands, 2 plants from Bombril.
newsitem.headline: Procter buys 3 brands, 2 plants from Bombril.

text.p: Procter & Gamble Co said on Friday that it has agreed to buy three laundry detergent brands from Bombril SA of Sao Paulo, Brazil.

Proctor & Gamble said under the agreement it will acquire the ODD Fases, Quanto and Pop powder laundry detergents and two manufacturing plants -- one in Sao Paulo and one in Salvador, Brazil. The company said it will also acquire Finish automatic dishwashing powder detergent.

"This acquisition is an important one for us in Latin America," the company's executive vice president in Latin America, Jorge Montoya, said in a release. "Brazil is a huge market with 150 million consumers and one of the few major geographies where we did not have a presence in the laundry category -- a core category for us worldwide."
Procter & Gamble had sales of $35.3 billion worldwide in the fiscal year ended June 30, 1996, with about 6 percent of those sales coming from Latin America, company spokesman William Dobson said.
The four brands acquired through the deal announced Friday had sales of more than $100 million last year, Dobson said.
Procter & Gamble said it has been in Brazil since the mid-1980s.
